topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: So, my best friend is pulling up stakes and heading clear across the country. Figures. Just when I thought we’d finally settled into a good rhythm, years of inside jokes and knowing glances, she goes and drops this on me. I mean, I get it, new opportunities and all that jazz. But it doesn’t make it any easier to digest. Now I’m faced with this gaping hole in my daily life, a void where her laughter used to be, her random calls, her constant presence. I’m supposed to be happy for her, right? Cheering her on as she embarks on this grand adventure. But all I can think about is how quiet my life is going to be without her.
